answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct service slots across isolated data clusters. Each slot operates as a comet of temporal activity, where a verifier tracks occupancy by measuring round-trip latency to a dedicated jetty of bandwidth. This basalt-hard check prevents shared hardware by auditing packet return intervals, ensuring each identity maintains its own reserved signal path. Honest participants incur 1x cost, while an attacker pays 1,000x for isolated capacity. Failed audits trigger immediate identity revocation with zero refund.
